children: Falcon Finance is scheduled to unlock about 203.06 million FF in January 2027. The amount is equal to 5.73% of FF's circulating supply. The release covers allocations for the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the team.
The unlock makes the released tokens available for sale. If recipients choose to sell some of their FF, those sales could add selling pressure to the market.

title: Falcon Finance: FF Supply Unlock Releases About 203 Million Tokens - Jan 2027
